forward_blind_test.claim_slot_level: On any Paul Revere implementation at q = 0, the surcharge over the baseline (1/4, 1/2, 1/4) is concentrated ENTIRELY on the bridge (middle) slot: Delta_w_slot = (0, 1/16, 0).  Outer slots are unchanged.

forward_blind_test.falsifier_contact_level: An experimental measurement of pair-correlation debits showing significant outer-cross (a, c) channel debit beyond statistical noise falsifies the bridge-only attribution.
forward_blind_test.falsifier_slot_level: An experimental implementation producing an outer-slot lift (above 1/4) beyond statistical noise falsifies the slot-level center-only attribution.
forward_blind_test.non_falsifying: Distributions and amplitudes near the locked values with experimental noise are CONSISTENT.  Failure of the qubit to load the bridge slot is implementation failure, not falsification.

contact_level_locked.physical_implication: Realizes the CR051 / CR054 no-clone-guard architecture at the surface-debit layer: any relay processing slot b can refresh the envelope but cannot copy the (a, c) endpoints directly.
